question_or_proposition: Should the nominated prohibition against discharge of visible films of oil, globules of oil, grease or solids in or on the water, or coatings on stream banks be classified as an enforceable effluent limitation that falls outside numeric exceedance comparison and instead requires qualitative or visual compliance evaluation?
required_context: Adjacent limit in the same FLOATING SOLIDS, VISIBLE FOAM AND/OR OILS section prohibiting floating solids or visible foam in other than trace amounts
Following sentence requiring samples to be taken at the discharge after the treatment system and prior to the receiving stream
Part I monitoring and reporting provisions on no-discharge reporting and excursion reporting for effluent limitations
notes: The nominated span is a qualitative visual prohibition rather than a numeric limit. Resolving its classification affects which limits are subject to numeric exceedance analysis (Purpose A) and how monitoring expectations without ordinary numeric results should be interpreted (Purpose C).
